Process water data

Source: R/data_pipeline.R
process_water.Rd

Reads, cleans, filters, and offsets a water file:

  1. Safely read the CSV

  2. Rename columns

  3. Drop unwanted cows & transponders

  4. Keep only specified bins

  5. Subset to desired columns

  6. Add an offset to bin IDs, so that water bin ID differs from feed bin ID

Usage

process_water(
  file,
  col_names,
  id_col = "cow",
  drop_ids = NULL,
  trans_col = "transponder",
  drop_trans = NULL,
  bin_col = "bin",
  bins,
  select_cols = NULL,
  bin_offset = 100,
  sep = ",",
  header = FALSE
)

Arguments

file

A single string giving the path to the file.

col_names

Character vector of names to assign to the raw data columns.

id_col

Single string: column name for animal IDs (default: "cow").

drop_ids

Vector: values in id_col to remove (default: NULL).

trans_col

Single string: column name for transponder IDs (default: "transponder").

drop_trans

Vector: values in trans_col to remove (default: NULL).

bin_col

Single string: column name for bin IDs (default: "bin").

bins

Numeric vector: bin IDs to keep (e.g. 2:4 or c(1,5)).

select_cols

Character vector: columns to retain in the final output. Default is null, select all columns.

bin_offset

Single numeric value to add to each kept bin ID (default: 100).

sep

Field separator; passed to read.table(). Defaults to ",".

header

Logical; does the file have a header row? Defaults to FALSE.

Value

A cleaned water data frame with shifted bin IDs.
